section: Revolutionaries abroad - India House, Ghadar Party, Berlin Committee, Komagata Maru

accepted.s: The revolutionary activities conducted from abroad during the First World War were significant mainly because they:
o: helped internationalise the struggle through arms, funds and foreign support
confined the freedom struggle to constitutional methods within India
restricted revolutionary activities to social reform organisations
ended the activities of Indian revolutionaries outside India
accepted.x: Revolutionary networks abroad gave the Indian freedom struggle an international dimension by arranging arms, funds and support from foreign countries during the First World War.
accepted.tq: Identify the broad significance of the development rather than recalling a single name or date.

accepted.s:
During the First World War, Indian revolutionary activities abroad sought support from which of the following countries?
1. Germany
2. Turkey
3. Afghanistan

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Germany, Turkey and Afghanistan are all specifically associated with the foreign support sought by Indian revolutionaries during the First World War.
accepted.tq: Check whether all the listed countries belong to the same wartime support network.

accepted.s: Which one of the following descriptions correctly identifies Darsi Chenchayya?
